name: Senge Iori
source:
A radical within the military who formulates and promotes the undead troops plan. 
However, all of these actions are for the sake of the Great Japanese Empire, and not for personal gain. 
He leads fourteen families of Shinto priests and possesses very strong supernatural abilities himself. 
A member of the new aristocracy.

"No matter how much you think about the country, what can you achieve in your current position? ...Nothing. That's why I will choose you for your own sake."
